name: Dal Shorba
steps: Wash the dal thoroughly. Chop onion, tomato, ginger and garlic finely. Heat ghee in a heavy saucepan and sizzle the cumin without allowing it to blacken.
Cook onion for 5 minutes until softened, then ginger and garlic for 1 minute. Add tomato and turmeric and stir for 4 minutes until the tomato breaks down.
Add dal and water, bring to a boil and simmer partly covered for 25 minutes until dal is very soft. Stir occasionally to prevent the lentils sticking to the bottom.
Cool sufficiently for safe blending and blend until smooth. Return to the pan, add salt and pepper and heat through; the shorba should be thinner than dal for rice.
Take off the heat and stir in lemon juice and coriander. Taste and serve hot in small bowls; reheat any refrigerated portion thoroughly before serving again.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
